display_information.name: Marshmallow Claims Fraud
display_information.description: AI agent for insurance claims fraud profiling — channel context, Salesforce Claim__c, and suspect scoring.
display_information.long_description:
The Marshmallow Claims Fraud Agent helps claims and SIU teams review insurance claims for suspicious patterns including delayed FNOL, photo metadata anomalies, garage clustering, bank detail changes, and channel corroboration gaps.

For each claim review, the agent looks up the *Salesforce channel* linked to the Claim__c record, reads Slack messages and files, reconciles with Salesforce, and returns a suspect score with next steps. If no channel exists, use **Create Salesforce channel** to open a record-linked investigation channel (canvas brief, pinned context, bot auto-added).

Open the agent from the Slack top bar (Agents & AI Apps) for streaming analysis, or use slash commands in channels.

assistant_view.assistant_description: Profiles insurance claims against internal fraud rules. Auto-matches the Salesforce channel linked to each Claim__c, reviews claim references (CLM-...), and creates record-linked investigation channels when missing.
